questions.question: What is the primary objective of Stock Verification in Indian Railways and Metro Railway store management?

options.A: To verify that physical stock balances match book balances and prevent leakage, theft, or accounting errors
options.B: To increase the basic pay of store keepers
options.C: To calculate daily overtime allowance for shop staff

questions.question: Which department in Indian Railways / Metro Railway holds independent administrative control over the Stock Verification Branch?

options.A: Stores Department
options.B: Accounts Department (headed by Principal Financial Adviser - PFA)

questions.question: Why is Stock Verification kept independent of the Stores and User Departments?

options.A: To ensure unbiased, impartial, and objective physical auditing of inventory
options.C: Because Stores staff do not know counting

questions.question: Who is the field-level official from Accounts authorized to conduct physical stock counting in store depots and user wards?

options.A: Accounts Stock Verifier (ASV)

questions.question: Who supervises the work of Accounts Stock Verifiers (ASVs) and conducts test verifications?

options.A: Inspector of Stores Accounts (ISA)

questions.question: What is the standard periodicity for physical Stock Verification of 'A' Category stock items?

options.A: Once every 6 months (or annually as per prescribed store code rules)

questions.question: What is the standard periodicity for physical Stock Verification of 'B' Category stock items?

options.A: Once every 12 months (Once a year)

questions.question: What is the standard periodicity for physical Stock Verification of 'C' Category stock items?

options.A: Once in 2 years (24 months)

questions.question: How often are high-value Non-Ferrous metal scrap and vital stores (like copper, brass) verified?

options.A: Once every 6 months / frequent surprise verifications

questions.question: What is the standard periodicity for verifying Imprest Stores held by Shop Senior Section Engineers (SSEs)?

options.A: Once a year (Annually)

questions.question: What is the periodicity for physical verification of Tool Room stock and Tools & Plant (T&P) items?

options.A: Once a year (Annually)

questions.question: How often should bulk liquid fuel, diesel, and lubricants in major depots undergo physical stock verification?

options.A: Monthly / Quarterly (or as per specialized depot schedules)

questions.question: What is 'Surprise Stock Verification'?

options.A: Unannounced physical stock verification conducted without prior notice to the custodian to check actual integrity
options.C: Verification conducted by outside private parties

questions.question: What is 'Special Stock Verification'?

options.A: Verification ordered specifically on suspicion of fraud, theft, heavy leakage, or by order of PFA/CWM

questions.question: When a Store Keeper or Custodian SSE is transferred or hands over charge, which verification must be conducted?

options.A: Transfer-of-Charge / Handing Over Stock Verification (Joint Verification)

questions.question: Who signs the physical tally sheets during a Handing/Taking over stock verification?

options.A: Both outgoing and incoming Custodians, along with the Stock Verifier / Departmental Representative

questions.question: What is 'Departmental Stock Verification'?

options.A: Physical verification conducted internally by officers/supervisors of the user department itself

questions.question: Does Departmental Stock Verification replace independent Accounts Stock Verification?

options.A: No, it is supplementary to Accounts Stock Verification and does not substitute statutory Accounts verification
options.B: Yes, it completely cancels Accounts verification

questions.question: What document is generated by the Accounts Stock Verifier when a discrepancy (shortage or surplus) is discovered during physical verification?

options.A: Accounts Stock Sheet (Form S-2311 / S-2312 or equivalent)

questions.question: What is a 'Shortage Stock Sheet'?

options.A: Stock sheet issued when physical stock counted is LESS than the book ledger balance
options.B: Stock sheet issued when physical stock is MORE than book balance
options.C: Stock sheet issued when material is brand new

questions.question: What is a 'Surplus Stock Sheet'?

options.A: Stock sheet issued when physical stock counted is MORE than the book ledger balance
options.B: Stock sheet issued when stock is zero

questions.question: Why must 'Surplus Stock' also be investigated thoroughly by Accounts?

options.A: Surplus may indicate unbooked receipts, improper issue records, accountal manipulation, or hidden shortages in other items
options.B: Surplus means money gained, so no investigation is needed
options.C: To gift the surplus to store keeper

questions.question: Within how many days must a Store Keeper / Custodian SSE submit an official explanation/reply to a Stock Sheet?

options.A: Within 15 to 30 days of receipt (as specified in store code rules)

questions.question: If a custodian fails to explain an unadjusted stock shortage, what action can Accounts take?

options.A: Issue reminder, raise a Provisional Debit against the custodian's salary, and recommend D&AR action

questions.question: What is 'Discrepancy Memo' handed over on the spot by ASV to the custodian?

options.A: Immediate written memo highlighting stock differences noted during counting before formal Stock Sheet preparation

questions.question: What document is updated and initialed by the Stock Verifier directly at the storage bin/rack upon completing physical count?

options.A: Bin Card (stamped with verification date, quantity, and ASV initials in red ink)

questions.question: What is 'Continuous Stock Verification' system in large Railway Stores Depots?

options.A: Systematic round-the-year verification program ensuring every stock item is physically counted within its prescribed cycle without shutting down depot
options.B: Counting all items in 1 single day by closing depot
options.C: Verification done only once in 20 years

questions.question: What is the main advantage of Continuous Stock Verification over Periodic Annual Closure Verification?

options.A: Avoids shop/depot work closure, spreads verification load evenly, and detects discrepancies early

questions.question: Who prepares and approves the Annual Stock Verification Program for a zonal railway / Metro Railway?

options.A: Prepared by Stock Verification Branch (ISA) and approved by Principal Financial Adviser (PFA)

questions.question: What is 'Test Verification' conducted by an Inspector of Stores Accounts (ISA)?

options.A: Re-checking a sample percentage of items already verified by an ASV to test the accuracy and quality of verification

questions.question: What percentage of stock items is standardly test-verified by ISA during super-checks?

options.A: Typically 10% to 20% of high-value / critical items verified by ASV

questions.question: What is 'Narrative Report' prepared by an Accounts Stock Verifier after completing verification of a ward?

options.A: Detailed report submitted to ISA/WAO describing general storage conditions, safety arrangements, bin card updating, and discrepancies found

questions.question: What is 'Scale Loss' or 'Driage Allowance' in stock verification?

options.A: Permissible minor weight/volume loss caused by natural evaporation, shrinkage, or handling in volatile liquids, coal, or timber

questions.question: If a shortage discovered during stock verification is within approved Scale Loss limits, how is it regularized?

options.A: Written off as natural loss under technical concurrence and competent sanction

questions.question: If a stock shortage is proved to be due to custodian negligence or theft, how is the financial loss recovered?

options.A: Debited directly to personal salary of responsible staff along with disciplinary action under D&AR

questions.question: Who holds administrative power to write off unavoidable stock losses/shortages up to specified financial limits in Model SOP?

options.A: Competent Authorities (CWM / DRM / PCMM / PFA / GM as per Model SOP Delegation of Powers)

questions.question: What is 'Stock Sheet Register' maintained in the Accounts Office?

options.A: Register tracking serial numbers, dates, wards, values, explanations, and final clearance status of all issued stock sheets

questions.question: What is 'Stock Sheet Clearance'?

options.A: Formal closure of a stock sheet after accounts accepts the custodian's explanation, recovery, or write-off sanction
options.C: Printing stock sheet on green paper

questions.question: How is physical verification of bulk timber or steel plates conducted when exact weighing is impractical?

options.A: By volumetric stack measurement and mathematical density calculation methods prescribed in Store Code

questions.question: How is liquid fuel (diesel/oil) stock verified in underground storage tanks?

options.A: Using calibrated Dip Rods / Sounding Tapes and Tank Calibration Charts with temperature/density correction factors
options.B: By emptying whole tank into buckets
options.C: By visual eye guess from top lid
options.D: By weighing entire underground tank on scale

questions.question: What is the role of RPF (Railway Protection Force) during stock verification of scrap yards and high-value non-ferrous wards?

options.A: To provide security protection, prevent unauthorized material movement, and witness verification of vulnerable items
options.B: To count stock items on behalf of ASV

questions.question: What is the periodicity for physical stock verification of Machinery & Plant (M&P) assets in workshop sections?

options.A: Once in 3 years (or as per zonal plant verification schedules)

questions.question: What is the periodicity for physical verification of Medical Stores in Railway Hospitals / Health Units?

options.A: Once a year (Annually)

questions.question: What is the periodicity for stock verification of Stationery, Forms, and Books held in stores?

options.A: Once a year / Once in 2 years

questions.question: In Metro Railway Kolkata, what is the periodicity for verifying passenger Smart Cards and Tokens held in Stores Depot custody?

options.A: Periodic (Half-yearly / Annual) + Surprise stock checks

questions.question: What is the primary role of iMMIS / WISE software in modern Stock Verification?

options.A: Generates online book balances, flags verification due dates, records digital field counts, and issues electronic stock sheets

questions.question: What is 'Field Tally Sheet' used by ASV during physical count?

options.A: Working sheet used on the spot to record raw physical counts, weights, or measurements before matching with ledgers

questions.question: Who signs the Field Tally Sheet at the end of physical counting each day?

options.A: Both the Accounts Stock Verifier (ASV) and the Custodian Store Keeper / SSE

questions.question: If a Custodian refuses to sign the Field Tally Sheet or Stock Sheet prepared by ASV, what procedure is followed?

options.A: ASV records the refusal note, gets it witnessed by another officer/supervisor, and reports immediately to ISA/WAO

questions.question: What is 'Re-verification' of stock?

options.A: Second physical check conducted jointly when custodian disputes the initial shortage/surplus figures reported by ASV

questions.question: During Joint Re-verification, if the original discrepancy reported by ASV is proved incorrect due to ASV counting error:

options.A: The stock sheet is withdrawn/cancelled, and explanation is called from ASV by ISA/Accounts

questions.question: What is 'Adjustment Pass' (or Journal Voucher) in Stores Accounting?

options.A: Accounting voucher processed to adjust book ledger balances to match actual verified physical stock after sanction

questions.question: Can a Store Keeper adjust book balances on their own without an approved Stock Sheet / Adjustment Pass?

options.A: No, unauthorized manual adjustment of book ledgers is a serious financial irregularity

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Scrap Lots' prior to e-auction?

options.A: Joint physical verification by Stores, Accounts, and RPF to certify lot description, boundary, and estimated weight before bidding

questions.question: Who signs the Lot Verification Certificate before a scrap lot is uploaded to IREPS e-Auction catalog?

options.A: Stores Representative, Accounts Stock Verifier / Representative, and RPF Inspector

questions.question: What is the purpose of verifying scrap lot boundaries with red paint markings in the Scrap Yard?

options.A: To clearly demarcate lot limits and prevent unauthorized merging or lifting of material from adjacent lots

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification Certificate' issued at the end of ward verification?

options.A: Formal certificate signed by ASV and Custodian stating that physical verification of all items in ward is completed

questions.question: What is 'Dead Stock Verification'?

options.A: Verification of non-moving, obsolete, or unserviceable items lingering in stores for long periods

questions.question: Dead stock items identified during stock verification are reported to which committee for disposal action?

options.A: Standing Surplus Committee / Survey Committee

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Custody Stores'?

options.A: Verification of stores materials drawn for specific sanctioned capital works and held in temporary custody of execution SSE

questions.question: How often should Custody Stores with execution engineers undergo physical stock verification?

options.A: Annually / Periodically during work currency and mandatory final verification before work order closure

questions.question: What is the consequence of failing to verify Custody Stores before closing a Capital Work Order?

options.A: Unused material remains unaccounted for, leading to capital cost inflation and risk of material loss

questions.question: Which officer in a major Railway Repair Workshop receives the monthly summary report of open/unadjusted Stock Sheets?

options.A: Chief Works Manager (CWM) / Workshop Accounts Officer (WAO)

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Emergency Breakdown Stores'?

options.A: Physical check of emergency relief train (ART/ARME) spares and Metro breakdown equipment to ensure 100% readiness

questions.question: How often should Emergency Breakdown Stores (ART/ARME / Metro Breakdown vans) be verified?

options.A: Periodically (Quarterly / Half-yearly) by departmental officers and annually by Accounts
options.D: Only after a major accident occurs

questions.question: What is 'Provisional Debit' raised against a store custodian on account of stock shortage?

options.A: Temporary financial recovery advice issued by Accounts pending final explanation or D&AR inquiry decision

questions.question: If a stock shortage is cleared satisfactorily after explanation, what happens to the Provisional Debit?

options.A: Provisional debit is withdrawn/credited back to the employee

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification Register' maintained by the Shop In-Charge / SSE?

options.A: Local shop register logging dates of stock verification, items verified, stock sheets received, replies sent, and clearance status

questions.question: Under Railway Code rules, what is the maximum frequency gap permitted between two consecutive verifications for any store item?

options.A: Must not exceed the maximum prescribed periodicity cycle for its specific ABC category

questions.question: What is 'Verification by Sampling'?

options.A: Auditing technique where random sample items are selected from a large homogeneous batch for detailed physical count
options.B: Counting all items in the world

questions.question: In Metro Railway car depots, stock verification of critical signaling cards and electronic modules is conducted based on:

options.A: Unique Serial Numbers / Barcodes registered in iMMIS database

questions.question: What document is generated when an item listed in book ledgers is physically missing/untraceable anywhere in the depot?

options.A: Shortage Stock Sheet (Untraceable Item Report)

questions.question: What document is generated when an unrecorded physical item is found in the depot with no book ledger entry?

options.A: Surplus Stock Sheet (Unaccounted Material Report)

questions.question: What is 'Misclassification of Stock' detected during verification?

options.A: Condition where item 'X' is physically stored in bin of item 'Y', causing artificial shortage in X and surplus in Y

questions.question: How is Misclassification of Stock regularized by Accounts?

options.A: By issuing contra-adjustment stock sheet entries balancing the corresponding shortage and surplus
options.C: By fining the store keeper 10 years salary

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification Report' submitted annually by PFA to the General Manager (GM)?

options.A: Annual summary report highlighting total verifications conducted, total stock sheets issued, total value of shortages/surpluses, and clearance position

questions.question: Which authority in Zonal / Metro Railway monitors overall clearance of stock sheets across all divisions and workshops?

options.A: Principal Financial Adviser (PFA) / FA&CAO (Stores)

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Oil & Chemical Tanks' safety rule for Stock Verifiers?

options.A: Never use open flames/naked lights near fuel tanks; use approved explosion-proof flashlights and safety harnesses
options.B: Use matchsticks for lighting deep dark tanks
options.C: Smoke cigarettes while taking dip measurements

questions.question: What is 'Volumetric Density Chart' used during liquid stock verification?

options.A: Standard conversion chart used to convert dip level height (cm) into volume (liters) and mass (kg) based on liquid density at measured temperature

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification of Permanent Way (P.Way) Stores'?

options.A: Physical counting of rails, sleepers, turnouts, and fastenings stored along railway track miles or in PW yards

questions.question: Who accompanies the ASV during Stock Verification of P.Way stores along track sections?

options.A: Senior Section Engineer (P.Way) / Section Mate or authorized engineering representative

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Scrap Rail Stacks'?

options.A: Measuring length, numbers, and calculated sectional weight of released rail stacks before e-auction
options.B: Weighing single rail on kitchen scale

questions.question: What is 'Write-off Sanction' for stock shortage?

options.A: Formal administrative order issued by competent financial authority approving removal of unrecoverable shortage from accounting ledgers

questions.question: Can a stock shortage caused by proven theft or embezzlement be written off without investigating responsibility?

options.A: No, thorough investigation, fixing of responsibility, D&AR action, and RPF/Police reporting are mandatory before write-off
options.B: Yes, written off immediately without asking questions
options.C: Yes, if shortage is below ₹100 crore

questions.question: What is the primary role of 'Stock Sheet Audit' conducted by Statutory Audit (CAG)?

options.A: Independent scrutiny of pending stock sheets, write-off sanctions, and delay in shortage recoveries to ensure financial propriety

questions.question: What is 'Verification Certificate for Imprest Stores'?

options.A: Certificate signed annually by Shop SSE and ASV confirming physical verification of all sanctioned imprest items held in shop ward

questions.question: If an Imprest Stock item shows persistent surplus during consecutive verifications, it indicates:

options.A: Sanctioned imprest limit is higher than actual requirement and should be reduced

questions.question: If an Imprest Stock item shows frequent stockouts and shortages, it indicates:

options.A: Sanctioned imprest limit is inadequate or recoupment procedure is delayed

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Unissued Manufactured Stock' in Workshop Stores?

options.A: Physical audit of finished components manufactured by workshop waiting for issue or transfer to Stores Depot

questions.question: Which accounting account is credited when unissued manufactured components are physically taken into Stores Depot stock?

options.A: Workshop Manufacturing Suspense (WMS) Account

questions.question: What is 'Verification of Returned Stores Ward'?

options.A: Physical verification of released serviceable parts and scrap items returned by shops via Form S-1539
options.B: Verification of brand new imported items

questions.question: Why is strict stock verification of Returned Stores Ward critical?

options.A: Prevents accumulation of uncredited materials, deters scrap pilferage, and ensures prompt credit to shop work orders

questions.question: In Metro Railway Kolkata, who coordinates stock verification of traction high-voltage spares held at sub-station depots?

options.A: Senior Section Engineer (Traction / Sub-station) jointly with Accounts Stock Verifier (ASV)

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification Tally Register'?

options.A: Ledger maintained by Stock Verification Branch recording target dates, actual verification dates, and ASV deployment across wards

questions.question: What happens when an item's physical verification reveals 'Zero Balance' matching 'Zero Book Balance'?

options.A: Verification is verified and recorded as NIL balance without any discrepancy stock sheet
options.B: A Shortage Stock Sheet is issued
options.C: A Surplus Stock Sheet is issued

questions.question: What is 'Over-stocking' highlighted during Stock Verification?

options.A: Condition where physical stock held is far in excess of reasonable future requirements, locking up capital

questions.question: What managerial action is recommended on 'Over-stocked' items identified by ASV?

options.A: Freeze fresh procurement, reduce recoupment limits, or transfer excess stock to other needy depots/railways

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification of Obsolete Items'?

options.A: Identifying items rendered obsolete due to technology change (e.g., old Metro stock spares) for survey and write-off

questions.question: Who signs the final Clearance Certificate on a Stock Sheet once all shortages are explained or recovered?

options.A: Inspector of Stores Accounts (ISA) / Workshop Accounts Officer (WAO)

questions.question: Why is strict adherence to Stock Verification authority and periodicity vital for Metro Railway Kolkata JE supervisory staff?

options.A: Guarantees 100% material availability for safe train operation, prevents audit objections, eliminates inventory waste, and ensures strict financial discipline
options.B: To increase paper filing in workshop office
options.C: To delay coach overhaul turnaround times
